instructions: Choose a timed CompTIA Network+ N10-009 practice exam from your course materials or another authorized educational provider. The official exam allows up to 90 questions in 90 minutes and includes multiple-choice and performance-based questions (PBQs). Set aside 90 uninterrupted minutes, close your notes and references, and work independently.

Check the time and question count at the start. Reserve time to revisit unanswered questions and PBQs. In a scenario, identify the requested outcome and the evidence that narrows the choice, such as a prefix length, a VLAN assignment or a change in interface counters. Eliminate answers inconsistent with that evidence. Flag uncertain questions where the provider allows it and return before submitting.

Complete the available PBQs during the timed attempt. If your exam has none, choose a separate Hub practical for Day 14. If you do not have a timed exam available, continue the study activities and leave this review as a draft until you complete one.

After submission, inspect missed, unanswered and guessed items. For each priority, name the technical concept, the clue you missed and a different scenario you can use to test your reasoning. Select a domain when the report cannot identify a numbered objective. Use only the percentage your provider reports. CompTIA's passing score is 720 on a 100–900 scale. A practice percentage cannot be converted to that score or predict a pass.
